reels.device: workout HUD + kinetic words in a window

reels.device: a live match broadcast: a scoreboard of Humidity vs Your Hair, humidity 3 – 0 up, then before/after replays bring your hair back to win 3 – 4
a garment care label sewn into the top of the frame: the lipstick is labelled like your favourite sweatpants (front: name, back: composition, size: shades), ending on a price hang tag

a lab gauge that tests the tube's printed claim live: a measuring bar with the label's 50 marked on it climbs on the build and lands past it at 56.6 on the drop, over a cut-out of her applying it on Minimalist orange
reels.smp: SPF 50 on the label, 56.6 in the lab.

reels.device: a coral waistband: one band across the frame carries every line; while gravity wins, the words roll down off it; when the tiny loop clips on, the band locks and the words stay up
reels.music: Shashwat Sachdev, Madhubanti Bagchi & Jasmine Sandlas — Shararat (From "Dhurandhar")

reels.device: zips: in the dark of a black-hole bag a torch beam hunts for the charger; on the bass a zip rips the dark open into Mokobara yellow, and each compartment then opens with its own zip and its item is found in 0 sec
reels.smp: In the Transit Z, time spent digging is zero seconds.

reels.device: Mummy's house rules handwritten in a list; as each one is broken, an evidence photo slaps onto a pile and the rule gets struck through in marker
reels.music: Sumitra Iyer, Anu Malik & Dev Kohli — In The Night No Control
reels.smp: Raised Right (mostly): tees for kids who broke every house rule.
